content.title: 2026 Tour of Flanders Weekend - Bikestyle Tours 🇧🇪
content.text: 3rd April, 2026 Get Ready to Conquer the Cobbles and Soak Up the Spirit of Flanders Step into the heart of Belgium’s cycling soul with our Tour of Flanders Weekend Tour, an unforgettable blend of challenge, culture, and celebration. This is your chance to ride the roads that have defined cycling legends and experience one of the most electric atmospheres in the sport. Based in the centre of the action, you’ll take on the same iconic climbs and cobbled stretches as the pros, Oude Kwaremont, Paterberg, and more, as part of the Tour of Flanders Sportive. Then, on race day, join thousands of passionate fans lining the barriers to witness cycling history unfold on the very roads you rode. With expert support, a like-minded group of fellow Classics fans, and access to prime race viewing, you’ll enjoy a weekend that’s as much about camaraderie and culture as it is about cobbles and climbs. For any true cycling enthusiast, this is the ultimate weekend in Flanders, authentic, unforgettable, and 100% Bikestyle Tours. Each bike is customised to your measurements before arrival and fully serviced by our professional mechanic to ensure top performance. Tour Overview Get ready to soak up the passion, the crowds, and the cobbles during one of cycling’s most iconic weekends. Our Tour of Flanders Weekend Tour is your chance to experience the energy of Flanders firsthand, both on the bike and from the roadside. Based in the heart of the action, you’ll take on the same legendary climbs and cobbled stretches as the pros, including the Oude Kwaremont and Paterberg. Ride the Flanders Sportive the day before the race, then line the barriers on Sunday to cheer the peloton through the very roads you conquered. The atmosphere? Electric. Whether you’re chasing personal cycling goals or soaking in the rich Flemish cycling culture, you’ll be guided by our experienced team, enjoy full on-road support, and share the journey with a small group of like-minded riders. It’s the perfect weekend for any fan of the Classics, up close, unforgettable, and all about the love of the ride. Your Itinerary Arrival at the Tour of Flanders DATE: 3rd Friday, April 2026 LOCATION: Gent, Belgium Your Tour of Flanders adventure begins! Our team will greet you at Brussels Zaventem Airport at 11:30 am, ready to kick off an unforgettable weekend of riding and race action. We’ll transfer you to the beautiful and vibrant city of Gent, your home for the next six nights. With its cobbled streets and riverside cafés, this historic Flemish gem is the perfect base to settle in and soak up the cycling culture that runs deep through this region. Once we arrive, it’s time to get your bike sorted, whether assembling your own or getting fitted for a rental, our friendly staff and mechanics are on hand to ensure everything’s running smoothly. After that, you’ll have the afternoon to relax, stretch your legs, or explore Gent’s charming old town. With Bruges, Antwerp, and Brussels just a short ride away, Gent puts you right in the heart of Flanders. From here, the Classics come to life. Tonight, unwind with a local beer, connect with your fellow guests, and prepare for a weekend of epic riding, racing, and memories. Tour of Flanders Cycle Sportif DATE: 4th Saturday, April 2026 LOCATION: Gent, Belgium Today, you don’t just watch history, you ride it. This is your chance to take on one of the most iconic routes in all of cycling: the Tour of Flanders Sportive. With thousands of fellow riders from around the world, you’ll line up and ride the legendary roads just 24 hours before the pros battle it out. Starting with an early breakfast prepared by our hotel in Gent, we’ll head straight to the start line, buzzing with anticipation. The 130km course is the true cyclist’s choice; it captures the heart and soul of Flanders, tackling the famous final 13 climbs of the pro race. Expect a day of challenge, camaraderie, and cobbles. Lots of cobbles. You’ll ride over the revered Molenberg, test your legs on the brutal gradients of the Oude Kwaremont and Paterberg, and grit your teeth as you tackle the Koppenberg, a steep, narrow, cobbled monster that has broken many legs and made many legends. After crossing the finish line and soaking in the atmosphere, we’ll regroup and head back to Gent. Time to relax, reflect, and recover, with a celebratory Belgian beer, a big serve of frites and mayo, and a smile that says, “I did it.” SHORT RIDE Elevation: 500m Distance: 80km LONG RIDE Elevation: 100m Distance: 145km Daily Highlights Ride the 140km Flanders Sportive, tackling legendary climbs like the Koppenberg, Oude Kwaremont, and Paterberg. Join thousands of passionate cyclists in one of the UCI’s Golden Bike events. Post-ride beers, frites, and stories back in Gent, just as the Belgians do it. The Tour of Flanders DATE: 5th Sunday, April 2026 LOCATION: Gent, Belgium Today is all about one thing, De Ronde van Vlaanderen, the Tour of Flanders, a true monument of world cycling. If you’ve ever dreamed of seeing a Classic in the flesh, with fans lining the narrow roads and the sound of cowbells echoing across the fields, this is your moment. The Tour of Flanders isn’t just a race, it’s a national celebration. The entire region of Flanders comes alive, pouring into the streets with flags, beers, and passion that has been passed down through generations. From the cobbled climbs to the fierce crosswinds, this race has crowned cycling’s greatest legends, names like Eddy Merckx, Tom Boonen, Johan Museeuw and more recently, Tadej Pogacar, who stunned the peloton in 2025 with a solo victory on the iconic Oude Kwaremont. We’ll get you to the heart of the action, with prime viewing spots along the route and the electric finish zone in Oudenaarde, where fans roar and riders collapse after one of the most demanding races on the calendar. You’ll feel every pedal stroke and be swept up in the spirit of Flanders; this is cycling at its rawest and most beautiful. By the end of today, you’ll know exactly why they call this the heartbeat of Belgian cycling. MEALS Breakfast, Picnic Lunch, Farewell Dinner Daily Highlights Witness cycling history unfold on the cobbles of one of the sport’s greatest one-day races Join thousands of passionate fans in Oudenaarde and along the course for a celebration like no other Watch the world’s best riders battle the brutal Oude Kwaremont, Paterberg, and more Daily Highlights Witness cycling history unfold on the cobbles of one of the sport’s greatest one-day races Join thousands of passionate fans in Oudenaarde and along the course for a celebration like no other Watch the world’s best riders battle the brutal Oude Kwaremont, Paterberg, and more Farewell from Flanders DATE: 6th Monday, April 2026 LOCATION: N/A All great adventures must come to an end, and today we say goodbye to the unforgettable roads, races and friendships that have defined our Tour of Flanders Weekend tour. These are the stories you’ll tell and the memories that will stay with you long after your legs recover. After one final breakfast together, we’ll arrange your shuttle transfer to Zaventem Airport in Brussels. While this chapter is closing, we hope it’s just the start of more cycling journeys together. Whether it’s chasing mountain passes in the Alps or the next edition of the Classics, we’ll be ready to ride when you are. Until next time, keep the pedals turning and the spirit of the Spring Classics alive.
